hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Model the traversal as finding shortest paths with time constraints on when vertices disappear.

hints.title: Pruning Invalid Paths
hints.text: When relaxing an edge to neighbor v, only proceed if the arrival time is strictly less than disappear[v].

hints.title: Priority Queue Steps
hints.text: Extract the minimum arrival time vertex. Discard stale entries, and relax neighbors that remain accessible at the time of arrival.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Dijkstra algorithm using min-priority queue with expiration filtering.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard BFS cannot handle varied edge lengths and time constraints.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory for adjacency list and distance array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Adapt Dijkstra algorithm to incorporate dynamic vertex availability thresholds.
